definitions.intra: Mean over classes with >=2 samples of mean distances of distinct same-class sample pairs
definitions.inter: Equal-weight mean over distinct unordered class pairs of mean cross-class sample-pair distances
definitions.gap_loss: FP gap-W3 gap; positive means smaller W3 gap
definitions.s_norm_loss: FP S_norm-W3 S_norm; positive means smaller W3 normalized gap

correlations: Average-tied-rank Spearman, 16 datasets separately in each model/mode; no p-values or held-out prediction claims. Adjusted correlations residualize both ranks on intercept and FP-accuracy rank only.
aggregation: First compute per-dataset metrics then take equal-dataset means; mean S_norm is not S_norm of mean distances.
limit: Existing compact metrics only; no raw feature recomputation. CAL features are raw-image backbone call, logits aggregate crop/flip.
